notes.title: Rap Attack - Steam Deck Compatibility & All-Time Low Price!
notes.content:
[p]You can play [b]"Rap Attack!"[/b] perfectly on your Steam Deck — it’s fully compatible.[/p][p]And right now is the best time to grab it, because it’s the [b]Summer Sale[/b] and the game is at its [b]biggest discount ever... a whopping 70% off[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44141513/2f92a35756029f34f468d5209be1d6928af640f0.gif"][/img][/p][p]I hope you enjoy it a lot — it’s packed with hours of fun.
[b]Will you be able to complete it 100%?[/b][/p]
